Name: V's Greenhouse
Author: VvVvVvV2222222222
Description:
This mod will change your Greenhouse to a bigger and more organised one. There's room for 15 trees and 216 crops. There's also some little easter eggs, like the wateringcan.


Greenhouse Stardew Dirt:
- This one has the coloration of the regular greenhouse in Stardew if you're not using a recolor mod.

Greenhouse Dark Dirt:
- This one changes the dirt and the wood to a darker version.


Greenhouse Recolor:
- This one will change the dirt, the wood and a couple of other things to the color of the recolor mod you're using. Though only if the recolor mod changes the tileset for the TownInterior. You can check your recolor mod's assets. If it has a TownInterior.png it will most likely change some stuff. Some other things like the tiles and the walls cannot change, because I added new tiles like the rug and otherwise it would make your greenhouse look weird.



Credits:
I used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34984615]Eemee[/url]'s flowers, but I added a pot.
